name: qBittorrent
author: Viboplr
description: Control a qBittorrent WebUI from Viboplr: add magnet links, choose what downloads, watch progress, and play or import finished files. Requires qBittorrent 5.2.3+ and an API key.

apiUsage.reason: Talk to your qBittorrent WebUI (login, list torrents, add and control them)
Remember your server address and API key, and cache each torrent's file names so the list filter can search inside torrents
Play completed files straight out of a torrent
Read title, artist and album out of a finished file instead of guessing from its name
Rescan your library when a download finishes inside it
Play any track straight from a file your torrents already hold
Download a track by finding it in your torrents — or, if enabled, by searching for a torrent that has it
